description: Cost of one request from the recorded prices and the channel's billing rules (long-context thresholds, time-of-day prices, thinking-token billing), each rule with its source excerpt. Where the sources leave a question open the answer is a range with the reason, never a guess; a price that is not recorded is unknown. List prices as published by each channel at observed_at, USD per 1M tokens unless stated; China-site price lists are in CNY, listed separately and never converted. Standard (on-demand) plan unless service_plan says otherwise. The channel's own page is authoritative. Aggregator prices are the marketplace's own and never the reference. A missing price is unknown, not free. Not purchasing advice.

at.description: Request time, ISO 8601, for channels that price by time of day

channel.description: Channel id; default is the official channel

model.description: Model id such as openai/gpt-6.1-sol, or an alias the channels use (gpt-6.1-sol, claude-opus-5-5). Case-insensitive.

output_tokens.description: Visible output tokens, without thinking tokens

reasoning_tokens.description: Thinking / reasoning tokens, counted separately from output_tokens

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate the cost of one request
